answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID=l.ID WHERE (l.CRP LIKE '%+%' OR l.CRP LIKE '>%' OR (l.CRP GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(l.CRP AS REAL)>=1.0)) AND p.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient p WHERE p.Admission='-' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND (l.HCT<29 OR l.HCT>52)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)>16)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP-8.5),3) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID=l.ID WHERE p.SEX='F' AND l.TP>8.5 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID=p.ID AND (e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR e.Diagnosis LIKE '%systemic lupus%'))
SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) FROM Patient p WHERE p.SEX IN ('F','M') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)>32) GROUP BY p.SEX
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND Thrombosis>0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient p WHERE p.SEX='F' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL AND l.DNA<>'' AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL)<8)
SELECT p.ID,p.SEX,l.Date,l."U-PRO" FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=p.ID WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND l.Date=(SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory m WHERE m.ID=p.ID AND m."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL)

SELECT p.Birthday FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=p.ID WHERE l.GPT<60 AND p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(RNP AS REAL)>=16) GROUP BY p.ID ORDER BY MAX(l.GPT) DESC, p.ID ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT CAST((julianday(l.Date)-julianday(p.Birthday))/365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age, p.Diagnosis FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID=l.ID WHERE p.Admission='+' AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL AND l.DNA<>'' ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(p.SEX='F')-SUM(p.SEX='M') FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=p.ID WHERE l.Date=(SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory m WHERE m.ID=p.ID) AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)>=32
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX='F' AND Admission='+' AND "First Date" BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND "First Date" BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28' ORDER BY Birthday ASC, ID ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"),1) FROM Examination WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31' AND (Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR Diagnosis LIKE '%systemic lupus%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
SELECT SUM(SEX='M') AS male, SUM(SEX='F') AS female FROM Patient p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l.GPT>=60)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l.SM IN ('negative','0')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID=p.ID) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID=p.ID AND e.Thrombosis>0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND l."U-PRO" IN ('30','100','300','>=300','>=1000','+1(30)','+2(100)'))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID=p.ID WHERE p.SEX='F' AND l.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0 AND (l.FG<150 OR l.FG>450) AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)>15
